items.title: From Atari to EVE Online: Building on 15 Years of AI Research in Games
items.content: Google DeepMind partners with game studios to prototype breakthrough AI gameplay.
items.contentSnippet: Google DeepMind partners with game studios to prototype breakthrough AI gameplay.

summaries.zh: 谷歌DeepMind与游戏工作室合作，共同打造突破性AI游戏玩法原型。文章回顾了其15年来在游戏AI领域的研究历程，从早期的Atari游戏到《EVE Online》等复杂作品，展示了AI从基础玩法到应对复杂场景的持续演进。此次合作旨在将研究成果应用于实际游戏开发，探索AI在游戏中的新可能性。内容聚焦于技术进展与产业协作，未涉及具体细节或评价。
summaries.en: Google DeepMind is partnering with game studios to prototype breakthrough AI-driven gameplay. This work builds on 15 years of AI research in games, spanning early Atari experiments to later projects involving EVE Online. The focus is on applying that research foundation to create new gameplay experiences. No further specifics are provided in the source.

items.summary: 谷歌DeepMind与游戏工作室合作，共同打造突破性AI游戏玩法原型。文章回顾了其15年来在游戏AI领域的研究历程，从早期的Atari游戏到《EVE Online》等复杂作品，展示了AI从基础玩法到应对复杂场景的持续演进。此次合作旨在将研究成果应用于实际游戏开发，探索AI在游戏中的新可能性。内容聚焦于技术进展与产业协作，未涉及具体细节或评价。

items.title: Putting sign language AI into users’ hands
items.content: Introducing sign-language-to-text (SL2T), our breakthrough model powering new sign language features for Deaf and hard of hearing users.
items.contentSnippet: Introducing sign-language-to-text (SL2T), our breakthrough model powering new sign language features for Deaf and hard of hearing users.

summaries.zh: 该文章介绍了一项名为“手语转文本”（SL2T）的突破性模型，该模型为失聪和听障用户提供新的手语功能。其核心是将手语实时转换为文字，帮助用户更便利地沟通。文章强调这一技术直接交到用户手中，体现了AI在手语识别领域的应用进展。
summaries.en: The article introduces sign-language-to-text (SL2T), a new AI model described as a breakthrough. It powers new sign language features designed to assist Deaf and hard of hearing users by converting sign language into text. The focus is on making this technology available directly to users.

items.title: WeatherNext: AI model achieves breakthrough in forecasting cyclones

summaries.zh: WeatherNext是一款人工智能模型，在气旋预报方面取得了突破性进展。该成果展示了AI技术在气象预测领域的应用潜力，有望提升对气旋等灾害性天气系统的预报能力与时效，为相关气象研究和防灾工作提供了新的技术支撑。
summaries.en: WeatherNext, an AI-based forecasting model, has reportedly achieved a breakthrough in predicting cyclones. The advancement highlights the growing role of artificial intelligence in meteorological science, particularly for improving the accuracy and lead time of cyclone forecasts. This development could enhance early warning systems and support better preparedness for severe weather events. However, further details on the model's specific methodology, performance metrics, or comparison with traditional forecasting techniques are not provided in the available content.

items.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration
items.content: Gemini Robotics ER 2 helps robots reason, collaborate, and solve real-world tasks. It represents a step change in video understanding, tool orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration for robotic applications.
items.contentSnippet: Gemini Robotics ER 2 helps robots reason, collaborate, and solve real-world tasks. It represents a step change in video understanding, tool orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration for robotic applications.

summaries.zh: Gemini Robotics ER 2 提升了机器人的推理、协作与解决实际任务的能力。它在视频理解、工具编排和多机器人协作方面实现了显著进步，助力机器人更智能地应对复杂现实场景。
summaries.en: Gemini Robotics ER 2 is introduced as an advanced system that enables robots to reason, collaborate, and perform real-world tasks. It marks a significant advancement in three key areas: video understanding, task and tool orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration. These capabilities collectively enhance robotic applications by improving how robots interpret visual data, coordinate actions, and work together to solve complex problems.

items.title: We’re launching Lyria 3.5 in Google Flow Music, with advances across musicality, lyrics, vocals, and creative control

summaries.zh: 谷歌Flow Music发布Lyria 3.5，重点提升音乐性、歌词、人声与创作控制能力。该版本带来多项技术进展，旨在增强AI音乐生成的整体表现，并赋予用户更精细的创作自由度。此次更新进一步巩固了Flow Music在智能音乐创作领域的工具能力。
summaries.en: Google has launched Lyria 3.5 within its Google Flow Music platform. The update introduces notable improvements across several key areas of music creation. According to the announcement, the new version brings significant advances in musicality, encompassing the overall quality and expressiveness of the music generated. It also enhances lyrics generation, vocal performance and delivery, and provides users with greater creative control over the output. The release positions Lyria 3.5 as a more powerful and versatile tool for music creators using the Flow Music platform.

items.title: Our approach to bioresilience
items.content: Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs are sharing our joint approach to bioresilience and AI models.
items.contentSnippet: Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs are sharing our joint approach to bioresilience and AI models.

summaries.zh: Google DeepMind与Isomorphic Labs联合发布了关于“生物弹性”及AI模型的方法。他们分享了如何利用AI增强对生物威胁的抵御能力，涵盖模型设计、风险评估与应用方向。摘要聚焦其合作框架与核心理念，强调通过AI技术提升生物安全与应变能力。
summaries.en: Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs have announced a joint approach to bioresilience, leveraging AI models. This collaboration highlights their shared commitment to applying advanced AI to address challenges in biosafety and biosecurity.

items.title: Empowering India’s next generation of innovators with ATL Saathi
items.content: Google and AIM launched ATL Saathi, a Gemini-powered AI tool empowering Indian educators in robotics labs.
items.contentSnippet: Google and AIM launched ATL Saathi, a Gemini-powered AI tool empowering Indian educators in robotics labs.

summaries.zh: 谷歌与 AIM 合作推出 ATL Saathi，这是一款由 Gemini 驱动的 AI 工具，旨在赋能印度机器人实验室的教育工作者。该工具将支持教师在 Atal Tinkering Labs（ATL）中指导学生，助力培养下一代创新者。此举措结合人工智能技术，为印度教育工作者提供教学辅助，推动学生创新能力的提升。
summaries.en: Google and AIM have launched ATL Saathi, a new AI-powered tool built with Gemini to support Indian educators in robotics labs. The initiative aims to empower the country's next generation of innovators by assisting teachers in these hands-on learning environments. ATL Saathi leverages Google's Gemini AI technology to enhance the educational experience, providing educators with a valuable resource for fostering innovation among students in India.

items.title: Measuring the impact of learning with AI in Sierra Leone and beyond
items.content: Results from a randomized controlled trial show the potential of Gemini’s Guided Learning feature to boost engagement and accelerate learning.
items.contentSnippet: Results from a randomized controlled trial show the potential of Gemini’s Guided Learning feature to boost engagement and accelerate learning.

summaries.zh: 一项在塞拉利昂等地开展的随机对照试验显示，谷歌Gemini的“引导学习”功能具有提升学习参与度并加速学习的潜力。研究结果初步表明，该AI工具在真实教育场景中可能带来积极效果，为未来推广提供参考依据。
summaries.en: The article reports findings from a randomized controlled trial on Gemini’s Guided Learning feature in Sierra Leone and beyond. Results indicate the AI tool can boost student engagement and accelerate learning. The study provides evidence of AI’s potential to improve educational outcomes, highlighting the value of measuring such impacts in real-world settings.

items.title: Fast-tracking genetic leads to reverse cellular aging
items.content: Biologists use Co-Scientist to find novel factors that successfully rejuvenate human cells.
items.contentSnippet: Biologists use Co-Scientist to find novel factors that successfully rejuvenate human cells.

summaries.zh: 生物学家利用名为“Co-Scientist”的工具，快速筛选出新的遗传因子，并成功实现人类细胞逆转衰老。该方法加速了基因线索的发现进程，为细胞年轻化研究提供了新途径。研究结果展示了借助智能平台定位关键因子、推动抗衰老疗法发展的潜力。
summaries.en: Biologists are using an AI tool called Co-Scientist to accelerate the discovery of genetic factors that reverse cellular aging. The approach successfully identified novel factors capable of rejuvenating human cells, offering a faster path to potential anti-aging therapies. This research highlights the role of AI in streamlining genetic discovery for cellular regeneration.

items.content: We’re expanding access to Google AI Ultra subscribers globally and introducing a new capability powered by Street View.

summaries.en: Google is expanding access to its AI Ultra subscription globally. It also introduces a new feature powered by Street View, enabling simulation of real-world places. items.title: Gemini for Science: AI experiments and tools for a new era of discovery
items.content: A collection of science tools and experiments to expand the scale and precision of scientific exploration.
items.contentSnippet: A collection of science tools and experiments to expand the scale and precision of scientific exploration.

summaries.zh: 《Gemini for Science：开启发现新时代的AI实验与工具》介绍了一组面向科学研究的AI工具与实验项目。该合集旨在扩大科学探索的规模并提升其精度，将Gemini的人工智能能力应用于科学发现过程，以推动研究效率与准确性的提升，标志着AI驱动科学进入一个全新时代。
summaries.en: The article introduces "Gemini for Science," a suite of AI-powered tools and experiments designed to enhance scientific research.
